scripts.check:pack: [ -s dist/main.js ] || { echo "check:pack: dist/main.js missing or empty"; exit 1; }; if grep -rlE '@babylonjs/(inspector|gui-editor|loaders)|babylon\.guiEditor' --include='*.js' dist; then echo "check:pack: banned Babylon debug package referenced above"; exit 1; fi; if find dist \( -name 'inspector*' -o -name 'gui-editor*' -o -name '1~inspector*' -o -name '1~gui-editor*' -o -name 'viewer.js' \) | grep .; then echo "check:pack: banned artifact name above"; exit 1; fi; if find dist -maxdepth 1 -name '[0-9]*.js' | grep -E '/[0-9]+\.js$'; then echo "check:pack: purely-numeric chunk name above; chunkIds must stay named"; exit 1; fi; B=$(find dist -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.wasm' \) -exec cat {} + | wc -c | tr -d ' '); [ "$B" -le 26214400 ] || { echo "check:pack: viewer CDN surface ${B}B exceeds 25MB budget"; exit 1; }; echo "check:pack ok (viewer surface ${B}B / 25MB)"
